Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Sales Specialist team and bring your passion and talent to work!

Sales Generalist – Liquid Handling & Detection (France) – 100%

Ideally based in Lyon.

Are you passionate about driving innovation in laboratory automation and building strong customer relationships? We are looking for a dynamic Sales Generalist Liquid Handling & Detection to join our team,  whose scope covers the south of France.

In this key role, you will be responsible for developing and managing sales opportunities, supporting customers, and representing Tecan’s values in a diverse and fast-paced environment. If you are ready to make an impact and grow your career with a global leader in life sciences, we would love to hear from you!

Your role

• Serve customers by selling Tecan liquid handling and detection products in the assigned France territory.

• Act as the first-line liaison between Tecan and customers, identifying their needs and providing suitable solutions through a consultative selling approach.

• Achieve sales targets for the assigned product lines within the territory.

• Represent Tecan France with integrity and honesty in all business contacts.

Your background

• Master’s degree or equivalent, ideally in a scientific field.

• At least 3 years of sales experience in laboratory automation.

• Strong communication and negotiation skills; able to multitask and manage complex customer situations independently.

• Fluent in French and English.

• Practical computer skills; experience with CRM systems is a plus.

• Professional, engaging, and passionate about people interaction.

• Operates with honesty and integrity in all business contacts.

• Emotionally resilient and able to work in a dynamic environment.

What makes working at Tecan unique

• The chance to make it count and have an impact on the world of tomorrow.

• Working in an international and diverse environment.

• Opportunities to grow your career within the company.

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture.

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

Join Tecan, a great place to work!

Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work.

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (without picture and without cover letter; reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

Supply Chain Engineering Manager

Onsite – Morgan Hill, CA

Full-Time | Exempt

Make an Impact at Tecan

Are you passionate about solving complex supply chain challenges and building strong partnerships with suppliers and customers? Join Tecan as a Supply Chain Engineering Manager, where you'll play a critical role in supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), driving supplier performance, and ensuring manufacturing readiness from product launch through full-scale production.

In this role, you'll serve as the technical bridge between customers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams, leading engineering initiatives that improve quality, reduce cost, mitigate supply chain risk, and enable successful product commercialization. You'll collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Program Management, Planning, and Purchasing to deliver innovative solutions that support business growth and customer success.

If you're a technically driven problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys influencing cross-functional teams, and is passionate about continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Lead engineering activities supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) and sustaining production by identifying and resolving mechanical and manufacturing challenges.

• Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Program Management, Planning, and Purchasing to support production and product lifecycle objectives.

• Serve as the primary technical liaison between Tecan, customers, and suppliers to identify and resolve Design for Manufacturing (DFM) opportunities.

• Manage assigned commodities including machined components, sheet metal, mechanical assemblies, plastics, cable assemblies, printed circuit boards (PCBs), and related suppliers.

• Develop and execute commodity strategies that improve supplier performance, quality, delivery, and total cost.

• Identify and implement cost reduction initiatives that deliver measurable value while maintaining quality and supply continuity.

• Evaluate, qualify, and recommend suppliers during quoting, NPI, production transfers, and manufacturing scale-up activities.

• Support supplier transitions, tooling implementation, First Article Inspection (FAI), and production readiness for new programs.

• Provide technical expertise for supplier selection, manufacturing process improvements, tooling development, and strategic engineering projects.

• Resolve supplier-related issues impacting production, including quality concerns, material shortages, delivery delays, and manufacturing constraints.

• Identify supply chain risks and develop mitigation strategies that protect production schedules and revenue objectives.

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow?

  

 Tecan is a pioneer and a globally leading company in laboratory automation and a healthcare enabler. The company is improving people’s lives and health by empowering customers to scale healthcare innovation globally. Tecan enables customers to scale their innovation, whether in laboratory workflows for life science research, various applied markets and diagnostics or in product development and manufacturing for the medical market. Tecan delivers this broad range of healthcare products and services directly to end users or with OEM partners.

  

 Join our Global Sales Operations Team and shape your career on a global stage.

  

 Manager Sales Operations IVD & LS Partnering (80- 100%)

  

 Männedorf, Switzerland

  

 Your contribution

 As Manager Sales Operations IVD & LS Partnering you will be responsible for post-contract sales operations by compiling and analyzing sales reports, coordinating pricing and logistics, and ensuring accurate data management in SAP and CRM systems. It also provides user training, troubleshooting, and collaborates with internal teams to maintain efficient sales processes and reporting.

  

 You will:

 Compile, analyze, and report sales data, budgets, and forecasts using SAP and CRM systems.

 Coordinate post-contract sales operations, including price adjustments, quote creation, and logistics review.

 Support and train users on SAP and CRM tools, ensuring accurate data management and troubleshooting issues.

 Collaborate with internal teams to maintain efficient sales processes and participate in system enhancement projects.

 Act as a first-line helpdesk for CRM users and manage communication channels for sales operations.

 Monitor and verify sales allocations and contract implementation, initiating corrective actions as needed.

 Participate in commercial calls and meetings with customers, supporting the sales team on various commercial topics.

  

  

  

 Your background

 We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work. We welcome professionals with practical experience who are eager to build their career in global Sales Operations. You bring:

  

 Minimum 5 years’ experience in sales analytics or sales operations, actively using CRM and SAP business applications.

 Advanced MS Excel skills (including formulas, macros, and programming) and proficiency in MS Office.

 Experience working in international environments and as a project team member is an asset.

 Excellent English required; German and other languages are a plus.

 Strong communication, teamwork, process orientation, customer focus, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work under pressure and interact effectively with senior leaders.

  

 W hat makes working at Tecan unique

 You can expect a collegial and supportive team culture built on openness and trust.

 The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

 Working in an international and diverse environment

 The opportunity to grow your career in a company that values both legal excellence and business impact
